newsitem.title: FINLAND: YIT WINS FIM 50 MLN PIPE ORDER TO CHINA.
newsitem.headline: YIT WINS FIM 50 MLN PIPE ORDER TO CHINA.

text.p: Finnish construction group YIT-Yhtyma Oy said on Thursday it had won an order for high- and low-pressure pipes worth about 50 million markka to China.
"German power plant supplier Siemens Power Generation has ordered from YIT Power Oy a high- and low-pressure pipes' delivery worth 50 million markka for China," YIT said in a statement.
"There is an option for an equivalent delivery with the order which will be valid until the end of April 1997," it added.
Besides pipes, the delivery includes prefabricates and materials, piping design as well as the preparing of installation instructions, YIT said.
YIT Power -- a subsidiary of YIT -- aims to develop its businesses in Southeast Asia and China which are central areas in energy building today, it said.
